about: What each live run (npm run eval:live, real Claude models and Claude web search, 16 Nov 2026) taught us, and the commits that fixed it before the next run. Hand-written from the commit messages; npm run report checks every commit exists.

runs.title: Baseline: the 15 Nov build against the real models
runs.learned: The router missed its 1.5 s cap, so the search plan collapsed to one query and Opus searched on its own for 15 to 35 s. Some prices reached the answer with no gathered source behind them.

fixes.what: Planner and grounding guard: the subjects of a comparison are read in code; a streaming guard marks any price no source backs
The agent owns the search plan: one search per subject starts before routing, all in parallel; the answer model writes only from gathered sources; date readings and quoted questions rendered by code

runs.title: Agent-owned plan and the grounding guard
runs.learned: Search snippets dropped the quoted price bullets, the price reader missed '$50,' and past-tense old prices, unverified prices were not re-checked, and the nudge could announce the same change twice.

fixes.what: Snippets keep the search model's quoted price bullets; price reader handles '$50,', plurals and past-tense prices; unverified prices are re-checked; the nudge re-checks every fact of a subject with no repeat searches

runs.title: Snippet and price-reader fixes
runs.learned: 3 checks left, all 'every price is backed by a source': the guard could not tie some prices to the source that backed them (Supabase's $25 in the re-check) and counted the 20-seat team totals ($280, $400, $1,600) as unsourced.

fixes.what: Routing: a message with its own question is answered as that question; small talk has nothing to re-check

Grounding precision: a price belongs to the product named in its clause; a price backed by the source it cites passes; sourced unit price x the user's team size passes; 'Changed' means the value changed
Eval: the grounding check runs independently of the guard; honestly flagged '(unverified)' prices are counted apart
Time phrases: parts of a day ('yesterday evening', 'last night' past midnight) and 'on the 3rd'
Arithmetic and definitions answered without search; web text is data: injected instructions ignored, tag-like text defanged
Typed search-step events in the stream for the live search steps in the UI
Site logos fetched server-side: public hosts only, sniffed images, size and time caps, letter-tile fallback
Eval widened from 48 to 131 offline checks: late-night IST, same-day recall, small talk, no-search questions, rupees, contradicting sources, team totals, prompt injection, nothing-changed watchlist

runs.title: Widened suite: 12 scenarios
runs.learned: One miss, and it was the check, not the agent: naming the 23:40 question as last night's context is correct, but the check failed on any mention of it.

fixes.what: Eval: the late-night 'today' check fails only if the 23:40 question is quoted or dated as today
